description.value: An American multinational financial technology company that provides payment technology to merchants, card issuers and consumers.
A payment technology company that serves merchants, card issuers and consumers, processing credit card, debit card, digital and contactless payments.
A payments technology company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, that helps merchants, banks and consumers accept and process electronic payments.
A payment technology and software company.

product_description.value: Integrated payments, e-commerce and omnichannel services.
Payment services to merchants directly and through other financial institutions, including integrated payments, e-commerce and omnichannel commerce.

Merchant Solutions (authorization, settlement, chargebacks, terminal services); Issuer Solutions (payment products and services for financial institutions); and vertical software for restaurants, healthcare, education and gaming.

Merchant terminal rental, payment security, reporting and vertical software such as Genius and specialty POS software; accounts receivable automation and inventory management; and Netspend prepaid debit and payroll cards and demand deposit accounts.

business_model_description.value: Largely transaction-based; one profile also lists subscription SaaS, licensing and professional services.

customer_description.value: About 3.5 million merchants and 1,300 financial institutions in more than 100 countries.

Merchants, banks, financial institutions and consumers, with Issuer Solutions serving financial institutions.
Small-to-medium sized businesses, enterprise retailers, education institutions and others.
